page_title: MNT 1-3 ANG | Montpellier v Angers 12/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+9' 1 - 3 Benjamin Lecomte tries in vain to get back after he went up for that corner with time running out, but can only watch in horror as Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) takes aim and sends the ball into the unguarded net from distance. 1:3.
90+8' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
90+8' A precise short pass from Zinedine Ferhat releases Ibrahima Niane (Angers) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot well past the left post.
90+4' Haris Belkebla (Angers) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+3' The total number of attempts is 8:18.
90+1' Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) picks up a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot goalwards that crashes against the bar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
90+1' Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Himad Abdelli will be replaced by Pierrick Capelle (Angers).
90' Ibrahima Niane (Angers) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Benjamin Lecomte pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
88' Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Benjamin Lecomte makes a comfortable save.
86' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) receives a red card after his horrific challenge and is sent off!

84' Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle and Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
83' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
82' Substitution. Enzo Tchato is replaced by Khalil Fayad (Montpellier).
81' A spell of possession for Montpellier in an attempt to control the game.
79' The game is interrupted. Carlens Arcus (Angers) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.

77' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom right corner is blocked by Benjamin Lecomte, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
76' Substitution. Esteban Lepaul leaves the pitch and is replaced by Ibrahima Niane (Angers).
76' Substitution. Jean-Eudes Aholou makes way for Yassine Belkhdim (Angers).
73' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Romain Lissorgue had an easy-decision to make.
71' Jean-Louis Gasset prepares a substitution. Joris Chotard is replaced by Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier).
71' Here is a change. Teji Savanier is going off and Jean-Louis Gasset gives the last tactical orders to Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier).
71' The manager makes a subsitution with Theo Sainte-Luce (Montpellier) coming on for Issiaga Sylla.
69' 1 - 2 Goal - 1:2! Esteban Lepaul (Angers) receives a precise pass inside the box from Himad Abdelli and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the bottom right corner.
69' Half-chance! Teji Savanier (Montpellier) plays a pass into the box, but Yahia Fofana reacts well to snuff out the attack.
69' The Angers players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
67' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
65' Total attempts – 8:11.
62' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) replacing Jim Allevinah.
62' We are about to witness a substitution. Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers) is replacing Farid El Melali.
61' 1 - 1 Goal! Teji Savanier (Montpellier) puts the ball into the left side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Yahia Fofana.
61' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
60' The Montpellier players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
59' Referee Romain Lissorgue makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Montpellier. Let’s see what happens!
58' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Montpellier for a penalty. Play continues.

56' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) unleashes a promising shot towards the bottom left corner after his wonderful solo run, but Benjamin Lecomte thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
55' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yahia Fofana intercepts the ball.
53' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
50' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
50' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
47' What was Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
46' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Akor Adams (Montpellier) heads on.
46' Jean-Louis Gasset makes a switch. Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) is coming on in place of Rabby Nzingoula at the start of the second period.
46' Referee Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar.
43' Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
42' The current number of shots on goal is 2:2.
39' Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier) has tested the patience of referee Romain Lissorgue and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
37' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Teji Savanier (Montpellier), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
34' Farid El Melali (Angers) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
30' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Jim Allevinah is the provider as he slips the ball to Esteban Lepaul (Angers) who simply steers it home from close range. It's 0:1.
30' Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
29' 4:8 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
28' Florent Hanin (Angers) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Florent Hanin (Angers) is penalised for holding. Romain Lissorgue signals a set piece.
26' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
24' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Yahia Fofana is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
24' Some great controlled play and passing from Montpellier. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
22' Dangerous play by Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier). Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Carlens Arcus (Angers) attempts to put the ball in from a rebound with his long-range shot, but it isn't accurate enough, and the ball goes high over the crossbar.
21' Farid El Melali (Angers) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
20' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) jinks his way past multiple challenges and fires the ball from the edge of the box towards the roof of the net, but Benjamin Lecomte shows his agility and makes a save.
20' Florent Hanin (Angers) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
18' Angers are seeing far more of the ball now.
15' Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier) trips an opposition player and Romain Lissorgue signals a foul.
14' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
14' Flag goes up against Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
11' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
11' Yahia Fofana pulls off a great save to deny Becir Omeragic (Montpellier), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
9' Farid El Melali (Angers) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
8' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
5' Florent Hanin (Angers) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
4' Goal, no wait. Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for handball and Jim Allevinah (Angers) can't celebrate. Disallowed goal.
3' Some patient build-up play from Angers as they look to unlock the defence.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Angers will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Romain Lissorgue.
